summary: {person} checks whether the same tip allowance can apply to both the restaurant and the valet stand.
realLife: Denver reported that a hotel had applied a food-service tip credit to valets and door and bell staff and that workers recovered the shortfall.
gates: The local credit is limited by occupation and a hotel applies it across roles.
weights: A common payroll code increases the chance of the same error across departments.
inGame: needs: job duties, local credit eligibility and shifts.

turns.what: The departments already use distinct rates.
turns.pulledBy: Payroll codes match the work performed.
turns.writesBack: The review confirms the valet rate.

turns.pulledBy: Shift records distinguish the two jobs.
